value.rationale: The complete sharp L6/L2 norm range on the natural three-dimensional real centered affine subspace of every volume-uniform tetrahedron is a coherent norm-geometry classification. Sixth moments introduce a squared cubic-skewness invariant absent from fourth moments, and the extremal classes distinguish balanced versus one-outlier vertex spectra. Exact nonnegative deficits provide sharp structural descriptions rather than isolated numerical evaluations. The two simultaneous bounds for all affine data and all tetrahedron shapes are not an arbitrary parameter slice.
